Users sit back, place their feet on the plates and push them away, working the thighs, hips and calves against their own weight. The lavender frame stands apart from the orange and grey machines in our Fun Fitness range, which helps if you want the gym corner to match a society's colour scheme. A double unit is useful on walking tracks where people arrive in pairs. Sales can share the exact size and warranty cover on request. items.pText: The Leg Press Double gives two people a seated leg press each, on one frame finished in lavender with orange seats. Users sit back, place their feet on the plates and push them away, working the thighs, hips and calves against their own weight. The lavender frame stands apart from the orange and grey machines in our Fun Fitness range, which helps if you want the gym corner to match a society's colour scheme. A double unit is useful on walking tracks where people arrive in pairs. Sales can share the exact size and warranty cover on request. Our standard cover is 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, and the Leg Press Double warranty will be confirmed in your quote.

Each seat moves on a pivoting arm, so there are two sets of bearings to inspect and grease. On a double machine, uneven ground puts the frame under twist, so we grout it on soft soil and only use self-standing fixing on a firm, level base. Keep the space in front of both footplates clear.
